alyssa: Quick compat check: proposing minor contract tweak to /v1/ranker — adding optional response fields for deterministic tie-breaks and explicit null scores. Need thumbs from eng-platform + SDK owners. PR: https://github.com/redwood/ranker/pull/3456

mike: what's the exact change? :eyes:

alyssa: Two parts:
1) response may include "tie_breaker": "hex" for each item. If present, server guarantees tie-breaker ordering by lexicographic tie_breaker. If absent, clients must fallback to stable ordering based on original_index.
2) score can be number or null. Null indicates unrated/filtered item; treat as -inf for ranking. Also adding optional "original_index" int to preserve stable sort for legacy clients.

sara: can you paste sample request/response?

alyssa: ```
POST /v1/ranker
{ "queries": ["q1"], "items": [{"id":"a"},{"id":"b"}] }

200 OK
{ "results": [
  {"id":"b","score":0.92,"tie_breaker":"9f3a...","original_index":1},
  {"id":"a","score":0.92,"tie_breaker":"1a2b...","original_index":0}
] }
```

mike: what's tie_breaker entropy source? hash of item-id? algorithm?

alyssa: Use SHA1 hex of `id + ':' + model_version` (server-side). Seed is implicit via model_version so stable across same model. Documented in API docs. Backwards compatible: if client doesn't understand tie_breaker ignore it and use original_index.

sara: I'll update the JS SDK to map null score -> -Infinity in compare function. ETA EOD. cc @mike for review.

mike: ok. Also let's add a response header `X-Ranker-Contract: 2026-03-17;v1.1` so clients can detect. Good to log in telemetry.

alyssa: yes added to PR. Also adding tests for legacy clients.
